title: AI救经济？：耶鲁学者反会加剧困难，技术转型叠加人口结构变化
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now, the executive director, co-founder of the Budget Lab at Yale University, Juan Martha Gimbal.
segments.zh: 现在连线的是耶鲁大学预算实验室执行主任兼联合创始人胡安·玛莎·金巴尔。

segments.en: Martha, great to speak with you once again. As you point out in this piece, in this forecast piece for Bloomberg Weekend, the hope here artificial intelligence
segments.zh: 玛莎，很高兴再次与你交流。正如你在为彭博周末撰写的预测文章中所指出的，人们希望人工智能

segments.en: could help America innovate its way out of the demographic decline.
segments.zh: 能帮助美国通过创新走出人口结构变化带来的压力。

segments.en: Are you optimistic that's gonna happen? Not really.
Okay. She's just, thanks for coming on.
That'll end our segment. It's always great to see you off.
segments.zh: 本期节目到此结束。很高兴再次见到你。

segments.en: I think you're sometimes seeing this tendency from people to say, particularly in tech.
segments.zh: 我认为有时你会看到人们，尤其是科技界，有这样一种倾向：

segments.en: Oh, the population is aging. That's an economic problem. But AI is coming.
segments.zh: “人口老龄化是个经济问题，但人工智能来了，”

segments.en: It's gonna ride to the rescue. It's gonna save us all.
And I think one of the things that I think about a lot is that one, we haven't seen technological transition during a period of demographic decline
segments.zh: 我经常思考的一点是，我们从未在人口结构变化的时期经历过技术转型。

segments.en: before we've only seen it in the effects of exploding population growth.
segments.zh: 此前我们只在人口爆炸式增长的影响中看到过这种情况。

segments.en: And also these transitions don't overlap with each other particularly well.
segments.zh: 而且这些转型彼此之间并不特别协调。

segments.en: So really what you're doing is throwing one transition on top of another transition, and just likely compounding and making more difficult the effects of each of them.
segments.zh: 实际上，你是在一个转型之上叠加另一个转型，很可能加剧每个转型的难度。

segments.en: That's what I was gonna ask. It seems like it could almost be a one, two punch if you've got AI coming in and taking jobs and aging transitioning out of the labor market, what that does for disruptions and companies
segments.zh: 这正是我想问的。如果AI取代工作岗位，同时老龄化导致劳动力退出，这似乎会形成双重打击，给企业带来混乱和挑战。

segments.en: and how they cope with that. Exactly.
